name: Stratocaster Professional II
description: The Pro II delivers refined playability, tonal versatility, and aesthetic appeal.
detailedDescription: Featuring V-Mod II single-coil pickups for enhanced clarity and dynamics, the Pro II Strat offers a deep C-shaped neck with rolled fingerboard edges for supreme comfort. The 2-point tremolo with pop-in arm provides smooth pitch effects with excellent tuning stability.

name: Telecaster Ultra
description: Ultimate performance instrument with Ultra Noiseless pickups and modern features.
detailedDescription: The American Ultra Telecaster represents Fender's most advanced performance instrument. Its Ultra Noiseless Vintage pickups provide classic Telecaster twang without the hum, while the modern D-shaped neck with rolled edges and compound radius fingerboard deliver effortless playability for any technique.

name: Les Paul Standard '60s
description: Classic tone and appearance with modern reliability and playability.
detailedDescription: The Gibson Les Paul Standard '60s captures the essence of the beloved instruments from that decade, featuring a SlimTaper mahogany neck and Burstbucker 61 pickups for that sought-after vintage PAF humbucker tone. The AA figured maple top adds both stunning visual appeal and tonal complexity.

name: SG Standard '61
description: A modern take on the guitar that rocked the world in the early '60s.
detailedDescription: The Gibson SG Standard '61 recreates the legendary guitar that defined rock music. Featuring a SlimTaper mahogany neck and Burstbucker 61 pickups for authentic PAF tone, this SG delivers the performance and look that made it a legend. The lightning-fast neck and devilish double-cutaway body provide unparalleled upper fret access.

name: RG5320C Prestige
description: High-performance guitar crafted in Japan with premium components.
detailedDescription: Made in Japan at Ibanez's Fujigen factory, the RG5320C Prestige features a Super Wizard HP 5-piece maple/wenge neck for lightning-fast playability. The DiMarzio Fusion Edge pickups deliver aggressive clarity ideal for modern metal, while the Lo-Pro Edge tremolo ensures rock-solid tuning even with extreme whammy techniques.

name: AZ2204N Prestige
description: Professional-grade instrument with versatile tones and premium feel.
detailedDescription: The Ibanez AZ2204N Prestige combines vintage appeal with modern innovation. Its roasted maple neck delivers incredible stability and smoothness, while the Seymour Duncan Hyperion pickups cover everything from crystalline cleans to high-gain aggression. The Gotoh T1802 tremolo offers silky-smooth operation for expressive playing.

name: Soloist SL3
description: Shred-ready guitar with premium components for the serious player.
detailedDescription: The Jackson Soloist SL3 is built for virtuosic performance with its through-body maple neck and compound radius ebony fingerboard. Featuring Seymour Duncan humbuckers and a single-coil, it delivers versatile tones from aggressive metal to clean, articulate passages. The Floyd Rose 1500 Series tremolo handles extreme dive bombs with excellent tuning stability.

name: Rhoads RRT
description: Aggressive V-shaped guitar inspired by the legendary Randy Rhoads.
detailedDescription: The Jackson Rhoads RRT pays homage to one of metal's most influential guitarists with its iconic asymmetrical V shape. Equipped with high-output Seymour Duncan JB and Jazz humbuckers, it delivers crushing rhythm tones and screaming leads. The compound radius fingerboard and Floyd Rose 1000 Series tremolo provide the performance needed for technical playing.

name: Silver Sky
description: Modern take on a classic design, developed with John Mayer.
detailedDescription: The PRS Silver Sky, designed in collaboration with John Mayer, refines the classic bolt-on guitar with PRS's attention to detail and quality. Featuring 635JM single-coil pickups that deliver warm, clear tones with musical note articulation, the guitar's distinctive sound excels in both rhythm and lead playing. The updated vintage-inspired tremolo offers a refined playing experience.

name: Custom 24
description: The quintessential PRS guitar, combining versatility and exquisite craftsmanship.
detailedDescription: The PRS Custom 24 is the company's flagship model for a reason. With its distinctive figured maple top on mahogany body and 85/15 pickups offering remarkable clarity and extended range, it seamlessly covers every style from jazz to metal. The Pattern Thin mahogany neck and 24-fret rosewood fretboard provide smooth, fast playability across the entire range.

name: White Penguin G6134
description: Luxurious classic with distinctive looks and sparkling tone.
detailedDescription: The Gretsch White Penguin G6134 stands as one of the most visually striking instruments ever created, with its white finish, gold sparkle binding, and jeweled knobs. Its TV Jones Classic pickups deliver pristine clarity with the signature Gretsch twang and chime, while the Bigsby B3C vibrato allows for subtle pitch modulation effects.

name: White Falcon G6136T
description: Iconic hollow-body guitar with distinctive appointments and tremendous sound.
detailedDescription: The Gretsch White Falcon G6136T remains one of the most iconic and visually stunning guitars ever created. Its resonant hollow body with gold sparkle binding and jewelry-like appointments make a bold statement, while the High Sensitive Filter'Tron pickups deliver the quintessential Gretsch sound with remarkable clarity and dynamic response.

name: Jim Root Stratocaster
description: Stripped-down, high-performance instrument designed for aggressive styles.
detailedDescription: The Jim Root Signature Stratocaster provides the Slipknot guitarist's preferred setup for heavy music. Its mahogany body and EMG active humbuckers deliver crushing tone with excellent sustain, while the modern C-shaped maple neck with a 12" radius offers comfortable playing for fast, technical passages. The minimalist design removes tone controls to focus on pure output.

name: Hellraiser C-1
description: Feature-packed instrument for modern metal and hard rock players.
detailedDescription: The Schecter Hellraiser C-1 delivers crushing tone and premium features at an attainable price point. Its mahogany body with quilted maple top provides rich sustain, while the EMG active pickups deliver aggressive, high-output performance ideal for metal. The ultra-access neck joint allows comfortable playing all the way to the 24th fret.

name: Pacifica 112V
description: Exceptional value instrument with features beyond its price point.
detailedDescription: The Yamaha Pacifica 112V brings premium features to an affordable price point. With its solid alder body, versatile HSS pickup configuration, and smooth maple neck with rosewood fingerboard, it delivers quality sound and playability that outperforms many guitars twice its price. The vintage-style tremolo adds expressive capabilities for blues, rock, and beyond.

name: Revstar RSS20
description: Modern design inspired by vintage Japanese motorcycles and cafe racer culture.
detailedDescription: The Yamaha Revstar RSS20 combines vintage aesthetics with modern playability and tone. Its chambered mahogany body with maple top delivers resonant, balanced sound, while the P-90-style Alnico V pickups provide rich, dynamic tones with plenty of bite. The dry switch introduces a passive filter that simulates the tone of a coil split without the volume loss.
